newsitem.title: UK: Euro jet premiums hold after flurry of trades.
newsitem.headline: Euro jet premiums hold after flurry of trades.

text.p: European jet fuel premiums were steady on Friday, although outright prices were hit by weaker futures.
April IPE gas oil expired at 1100 GMT down $2.25 a tonne at $160.25 and May IPE gas oil last traded at $160.50, down $3.75.
Business was quieter on Thursday after a spate of deals earlier in the week.
"The big clear out has happened so it's much quieter. The market looks to have covered its shorts and the buying fraternity is getting relaxed," said one broker.
There was a feeling that positions should be taken in view of the contangoed market, but little was seen done.
Barge premiums in NWE were steady at May IPE +$17.50 fob ARA and cargo premiums were still pegged around $22-23 cif NWE.

In the Mediterranean EU spec jet fuel was assessed around high fob Med quotes +$8 although some sellers were optimistically asking for high fob Med quotes +$11. Libyan material, which earlier in the week had been done between high fob quotes +$5.50 and $7.50 was now hovering around high fob quotes +$6-7.
